PROBE GOTCHA worth keeping: spawn-then-kill inside ONE frame pays nothing, by design -- the lazy seeding rule treats a body it never saw alive as already settled (that is what stops a loaded save paying out its corpses). Round 1 of the probe did this and misread it as a passing delete-the-fix. Any successor probe must step 1 frame after spawning.

PROBE GOTCHA 2: H.writeSave/H.readSave are ASYNC; calling them synchronously inside page.evaluate silently does nothing. Also H.getFrame() returns a NUMBER, not a record -- read events via traceStart/traceDrain.
PROBE GOTCHA 3: hearthRest() refuses from anywhere not near a real well ('No sapwell within reach'); setAtHearth(true) only flips the UI gate. Teleport to listHearths()[0].pos first.

PROBE GOTCHA 4: without H.setCharacter(...) the engine carries a placeholder SIX-attribute Souls sheet and vigour feeds nothing -- hp_max sat at 620 and did not move. With a real sheet it is 196 -> 222.

BALANCE (first pass): level 2 = 418 souls = 3.1 sentry kills = 4.6 min; level 10 = 7.8 kills = 11.7 min; level 14 (end of R1) = 11.1 kills = 16.5 min. Averages to RI-PRG06 §5's 10.8 min/level over R1 BY CONSTRUCTION, because the anchor is RI-PRG06's own R1 mean kill. Minutes use RI-PRG06's 108 min / 72.5 killed = 1.49 min per killed enemy, NOT a node-arena TTK.

NODE TTK cross-check (combat-node, straight sword vs inf_trash): 21.7-23.4 s of continuous swinging, 15 landed hits through armour_rating 30. NOT used for any published number -- the node arena runs no stealth perception so the enemy never turns.
THE CROSSING pays 816 souls -> level 2 with 398 of the next 483 in hand; at night 1,102 -> level 3.

HEADLINE: every hand-placed enemy in the world (9) is worth 1,224 souls = level 3. RI-PRG06 §7 plans ~1,230 placed enemies for a first clear at L82. The curve, the values and the loop are correct and THE WORLD IS EMPTY -- the progression ceiling is a world-population problem now, not a soul-economy one.
